title: Not for warm beverages!
text: Not for warm beverages!. This product feels cheap to me. You can feel the seams where the plastic doesn't line up and leaves sharp edges. I purchased this for use with Soylent. The lack of a metal ball clacking around inside as I shake it is nice, but I feel like I have to keep a death grip on the plug part when I shake it or else it'll spill all over the place. I did once try to add some hot cocoa to my Soylent to give it a bit of sweetness. That was a big mistake. Even holding the plug shut, the pressure inside ended up forcing it open and spraying me with Soylent and hot cocoa powder.
